label: a short-vowel mark on a geminated consonant: the fatha/damma/kasra token that precedes a shadda in fully vocalized Arabic (0.26-0.60) or the vowel before a dagesh in pointed Hebrew (0.99); vocalized words without gemination (0.03-0.06) and unvocalized text (0.015) are silent

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit

notes: Card: max 91.5, density 0.005%, peaks 'َ' x12, 'ِ' x11, 'ُ' x6 and the Hebrew qamats before a dagesh: every example is the vowel immediately before ّ (يُحِلُّ, يُقَوِّيهِ, المُقَدَّسَةِ, يَتَجَنَّبُهَا, تتكوَّن, التحدُّث) or ּ (הַמָּקוֹם). The tokenizer normalizes diacritic order so the vowel always precedes the shadda, and each mark is its own token, so the pole reads the vowel and predicts the shadda. Probe: يُحِلُّ 0.596, التَّحَدُّث 0.306, المُقَدَّسَةِ 0.305, يَتَجَنَّبُهَا 0.279, مُحَمَّدٌ 0.257, Hebrew הַמָּקוֹם 0.987; vocalized without shadda 0.025 and 0.062, unvocalized 0.015. Fire items are fresh vocalized phrases with a geminated consonant (two Hebrew with dagesh); near misses are vocalized phrases with moon-letter articles and no shadda, plus pointed Hebrew without dagesh.
